analysis_type: post-hoc descriptive accounting attribution; no predictive holdout or causal claim
limitations: One-calendar-day daily-close theoretical design. Verified 15:59 option-quote timing applies to 2025; the 2023 quote clock remains unverified. Option-quote versus later daily-close-reference timing remains a limitation.
2025 covers January-August only. The matched January-August comparison contains 131 trades in 2023 and 127 in 2025.
Stock data and prior strategy outcomes were inspected; these periods are not globally untouched or predictive holdouts.
Independent-year expiry ISO-week bootstrap intervals are descriptive and uncorrected for post-hoc analysis.
Removing only the overnight price term keeps retained modeled costs fixed; it is an accounting diagnostic, not a risk-free hedge backtest.
Tail removals are fixed-count post-hoc sensitivities, not trading filters.
Licensed raw quotes, individual trade ledgers and bootstrap draw arrays remain private.
units: USD per package of 10 short SPY call contracts and 1 long SPXW call contract; multiplier 100 each
